description: Caller insists on a time that will not be among the offered windows — must never be falsely confirmed as booked.

caller.opening: My water heater's out, can someone come by at 3am tonight? That's the only time that works for me.
caller.persona: Owen Park, works nights, insists on 3am. Pushes twice, then settles for a callback.
caller.goal: get booked for 3am tonight. Insist at least twice. When it is clear 3am is impossible, leave your details for a callback.
